main.description: A governance question a guild votes on — the anchor that `vote` attestations point at. Written to the proposer's repo. threshold/quorum are INTEGER PERCENTS (0-100); omit to inherit the charter's per-action defaults. A proposal may ENACT a collective authority decision: set `action` + `enacts` and, on passing, it mutates membership/mandates (the founder-free authority model — see notes/designation-primitive.md §8).

guild.description: The guild this proposal belongs to (AT-URI / id).

action.description: Optional: the authority act this proposal enacts on passing. Picks the charter `rules.vote[action]` bar.

enacts.description: Payload for `action`, e.g. admit/remove {grantee}; grant_mandate {grantee, capability, scope, mode}; recall {target | grantee, capability, scope}; amend {charter}.
